pieces.name: ColorModeButton
pieces.note: the asf shell's light and dark switch, exported as a piece of its own, so an app's own shell can carry it (CSS ERP, D-150)

pieces.name: DataTable and FilterBar (extended)
pieces.note: the lists of an ERP: cards on phones (cardRenderer), row selection with a bulk bar, sort, row open and row actions, column priority and numeric columns, numbered pages and cursor paging with load more; the filter bar adds a delayed search, status chips, removable active filters and a filters panel on phones (CSS ERP, D-150)

pieces.name: Choices: Checkbox, CheckboxGroup, RadioGroup, Switch, Combobox, SelectField (extended)
pieces.note: the choices of the ERP's forms: an "other" choice opening a text box inside the same field, disabled options, a select that becomes a combobox above 10 options, and a combobox for server search or free text (CSS ERP, D-150); screenshot in the gallery step

pieces.name: TextField (extended), ErrorSummary, FormSection
pieces.note: the text kinds of the ERP's forms (identity number, integer, decimal, money with the taka sign, mobile number, password with a show button; Bengali digits typed become English digits), a record field's states (locked with a correction link, changed with its previous value, officials only), an action inside a field's end, the error summary that links to each field, and the form section as a fieldset (CSS ERP, D-150); screenshot in the gallery step

pieces.name: Dialog (extended), ConfirmDialog, Menu, Drawer (bottom sheet)
pieces.note: the overlays of the ERP: a dialog that stays open while saving and fills a phone for a long form, a confirm dialog with what follows, a required reason and a busy confirm, a menu of links and actions for rows and profiles, and the drawer as a bottom sheet on phones (CSS ERP, D-150); screenshot in the gallery step
